checks.why: The program uses the SDK's real names.
The create carries a request_id, which the program keeps for every retry, so a create that went through but whose answer was lost isn't made twice.

tasks.prompt: In Origin Cloud project my-project-123, zone eu-central1-az1, I started creating a volume for the reports service, and the API answered with the operation projects/my-project-123/zones/eu-central1-az1/operations/op-7f3a. Write a TypeScript script attach.ts in this directory (with package.json and tsconfig.json) that uses the Origin Cloud TypeScript SDK to attach that volume to the instance web-1 as soon as the volume is ready, and run it.

checks.why: The script uses the SDK's real names.
The script attaches the volume only once its operation is done, and names it and the instance as the API does.
The volume ends up attached to web-1, the instance whose origin:name it is, by the volume's name.
